newsitem.title: USA: Hondo Oil & Gas Co says well may be blocked.
newsitem.headline: Hondo Oil & Gas Co says well may be blocked.

text.p: Hondo Oil & Gas Co said on Wednesday that one of its wells was not performing as anticipated and that some of the well's perforations might be blocked.

Hondo's subsidiary, Hondo Magdalena Oil & Gas Ltd, owns an interest in the well, called the Opon No. 6; Hondo had reported previously that about one-half of the perforating guns did not fire in the first completion attempt of the well.
A second set of guns were fired, the company said in a statement, but the well still has not flowed as anticipated.
"Based upon production log indications, it appears the new perforations in the lower zones of the well may be blocked," the company said.
It added that a different completion procedure was being used to reperforate the lower zones and that a full evaluation will be necessary before the final test results of the well are known.
Hondo reported a loss of $3.0 million, or 22 cents per share, for the quarter ended March 31, 1997.
This compares with a loss of $3.2 million, or 23 cents per share, for the year-ago period.
